name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan's fascination with aerodynamics started early, fueled by a childhood spent building model airplanes and poring over engineering books. He secured a degree in aeronautical engineering from Trinity College Dublin, after which he honed his skills at a small aerospace firm specializing in wind tunnel testing. The lure of motorsport proved too strong, and he transitioned to Formula Student, designing aero packages for the university team. His work caught the attention of Sprint Masters, who offered him a junior role in their aero department. 

Over the years, Declan steadily climbed the ranks, proving his worth with innovative designs and a keen eye for detail. He believes in a holistic approach to aerodynamics, emphasizing the importance of not only maximizing downforce but also minimizing drag. His commitment to perfection and ability to see the bigger picture have made him an invaluable asset to the team, and he recently took the Head of Aero role. His focus is on integrating simulation and real-world testing to create a cohesive and effective development process.

Declan’s distinctive approach lies in his talent for bridging the gap between theoretical concepts and practical application. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and is always looking for ways to push the boundaries of aerodynamic performance. His passion is contagious, inspiring his team to strive for excellence and embrace innovation.
